$comment: Keeps the host SDK (Rider builds) and the container SDK (docker compose) agreeing on
what 'net10.0' means. Rider uses whatever pacman installed; the container image ships a
different feature band. Without this, the two can diverge and you get 'works in Rider,
rollForward 'latestFeature' accepts any 10.0.x SDK at or above the 100 band, so both the
Arch package and the mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:10.0 image satisfy it, while a stray
.NET 9 or 11 SDK would be rejected with a clear error instead of silently building.
